title: Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: Super Micro reports preliminary Q1 revenues of $18.5B to $19.5B, vs. $15B est., and gross margins of 12% to 12.5%; SMCI jumps 11%+ after hours — Super Micro Computer Inc. jumped in late trading after reporting preliminary quarterly results that topped analysts' estimates.
